title: Vulpes Music Discs
description: An alternate take on Minecraft's music discs.
body:
**Vulpes Music Discs is my personal tweak of the textures for Minecraft's music discs soon coming to my Vanilla+ resource pack [Vulpes Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vulpes-vanilla) but released as a standalone for people who might want it. With this pack music discs will look a little more like real life vinyl records while still staying faithful to their general look and color schemes from the base game.**

![All the discs from 1.21.3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8y9efhbu/images/fc1fdbee0cd665746f207ca1527d58a0fc8c0355.png)
